# befui

> Copy-paste React components (Radix + Tailwind 4 + CSS variables) with real motion, plus HRMS and marketing blocks. You own the files: add them with the CLI, then import from `@/components/ui/<name>`.

## Setup
- One time: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui init` (theme CSS, cn helper, AGENTS.md rules)
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add <name> [name...]` or `add all`; blocks are `block:<name>`
- Icons: our own set in `@/components/ui/icons`, e.g. `import { SearchIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons'`; no icon package needed
- Theme: CSS variables in index.css (--primary, --ring, --accent...). Dark mode = `dark` class on <html>
- Full catalog with examples: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/llms-full.txt

## Components
- `accordion` (Display): Collapsible sections with a smooth height animation. Single or multiple open. Exports: Accordion.
- `alert-dialog` (Overlays): Confirm before something destructive. Cancel and confirm, controlled by you. Exports: AlertDialog.
- `alert` (Feedback): Inline message in info, success, warning and danger. Exports: Alert.
- `app-shell` (Layout): Sidebar, topbar and scrolling content area, plus a page header. Exports: AppShell, Topbar, AppContent, PageHeader.
- `avatar` (Display): Image with initials fallback in a stable color, plus a stacked group. Exports: Avatar, AvatarGroup.
- `badge` (Display): Status pill with semantic colors and an optional dot. Exports: badgeVariants, Badge.
- `banner` (Feedback): Announcement bar that collapses smoothly when dismissed. Exports: Banner.
- `border-beam` (Display): A light beam that circles the border. For pricing cards and featured content. Exports: BorderBeam.
- `breadcrumb` (Navigation): Trail of parent pages. Exports: Breadcrumb.
- `button` (Inputs): Thirteen variants from plain to glow, shine and 3D press, pill shape, five sizes, loading state, and asChild for links. Exports: buttonVariants, Button.
- `calendar` (Inputs): Month grid for one day or a range. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work. Exports: startOfDay, addDays, addMonths, isSameDay, Calendar.
- `card` (Display): Bordered surface with header, content and footer parts. Exports: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter.
- `carousel` (Display): Scroll-snap slides with arrows and animated dots. Exports: Carousel.
- `charts` (Data): Sparkline, bar chart and donut in plain SVG. No chart library. Exports: Sparkline, BarChart, DonutChart.
- `checkbox` (Inputs): Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows. Exports: Checkbox.
- `chip` (Inputs): Toggleable filter chips, single or multi select. Exports: Chip, ChipGroup.
- `collapsible` (Display): One section that opens with a smooth height animation. Exports: Collapsible.
- `color-picker` (Inputs): Swatches, hex field and the native picker. Always returns a six-digit hex. Exports: ColorPicker.
- `combobox` (Inputs): Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option. Exports: Combobox, MultiCombobox.
- `command` (Overlays): Searchable palette on cmdk. Bind it to Ctrl or Cmd K. Exports: Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem.
- `compare` (Display): Before and after slider. Drag or use arrow keys. Exports: Compare.
- `confetti` (Feedback): Burst of confetti from any button, or call fireConfetti(x, y) yourself. Exports: fireConfetti, Confetti.
- `copy-button` (Inputs): Copies text and morphs to a check. Exports: CopyButton.
- `countdown` (Data): Live countdown with flipping digits. Exports: Countdown.
- `data-table` (Data): Sortable columns, a filter box and pagination. You pass rows and column definitions. Exports: DataTable.
- `date-picker` (Inputs): Date and date range fields that open a calendar. Closes on pick. Exports: formatDate, DatePicker, DateRangePicker.
- `dialog` (Overlays): Centered modal and edge-docked sheet on Radix Dialog. Exports: Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogClose, DialogContent, SheetContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetHeader, SheetFooter, SheetTitle, SheetDescription.
- `dock` (Navigation): Icons that grow toward the pointer, like the macOS dock. Exports: Dock.
- `dropdown-menu` (Overlays): Action menu with checkbox items, shortcuts and destructive items. Exports: DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut.
- `dropzone` (Inputs): Drag and drop file area with size check and removable file list. Exports: Dropzone.
- `empty-state` (Display): Dashed placeholder with icon, text and an action. Exports: EmptyState.
- `gauge` (Data): Half-circle meter with a needle that swings to the value. Exports: Gauge.
- `icons` (ui):  Exports: BefMark, SearchIcon, CopyIcon, CheckIcon, XIcon, PlusIcon, MenuIcon, ArrowRightIcon, ChevronRightIcon, SunIcon, MoonIcon, SparkleIcon, ZapIcon, ComponentsIcon, BlocksIcon, LayersIcon, PackageIcon, PaletteIcon, BookIcon, CommandKeyIcon, MonitorIcon, TabletIcon, PhoneIcon, UploadIcon, ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronDownIcon, ChevronUpIcon, ArrowLeftIcon, ArrowUpIcon, ArrowDownIcon, SortIcon, MinusIcon, MoreIcon, RefreshIcon, InfoIcon, AlertIcon, AlertCircleIcon, CheckCircleIcon, XCircleIcon, LoaderIcon, ShieldIcon, UserIcon, UsersIcon, MailIcon, BellIcon, CalendarIcon, ClockIcon, HomeIcon, SettingsIcon, LockIcon, GlobeIcon, StarIcon, HeartIcon, BookmarkIcon, EditIcon, TrashIcon, DownloadIcon, FilterIcon, EyeIcon, EyeOffIcon, LinkIcon, ExternalLinkIcon, LogOutIcon, ListIcon, FileIcon, FolderIcon, ImageIcon, PlayIcon, PauseIcon, BarChartIcon, TrendingIcon, CodeIcon, TerminalIcon, icons.
- `input` (Inputs): Text input and textarea with icon, trailing slot, and invalid state. Exports: Input, Textarea.
- `kbd` (Display): Keyboard key hint. Exports: Kbd.
- `label` (Inputs): Label with required marker, plus Field for label, control and hint or error. Exports: Label, Field.
- `marquee` (Display): Endless logo or tag scroll with edge fade. Pauses on hover. Exports: Marquee.
- `number-stepper` (Inputs): Number field with plus and minus buttons and arrow keys. Exports: NumberStepper.
- `number-ticker` (Data): Counts up to a value with easing once it scrolls into view. Exports: NumberTicker.
- `otp-input` (Inputs): Code boxes with paste, backspace, arrow keys, autofill and a shake on error. Exports: OtpInput.
- `pagination` (Navigation): Page buttons with ellipsis for long ranges. Exports: Pagination.
- `password-input` (Inputs): Show and hide toggle with an optional strength meter. Exports: passwordScore, PasswordInput.
- `popover` (Overlays): Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Exports: Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverAnchor, PopoverContent.
- `progress-ring` (Data): Circular progress with an eased stroke animation. Exports: ProgressRing.
- `progress` (Data): Thin progress bar with four tones. Exports: Progress.
- `radio-group` (Inputs): Native radios as selectable cards with descriptions. Exports: RadioGroup.
- `rating` (Inputs): Star rating with hover preview. Read-only when no handler is given. Exports: Rating.
- `reveal` (Display): Scroll-in fade-up wrapper and a blur-in headline. One IntersectionObserver each. Exports: Reveal, TextReveal.
- `scroll-progress` (Navigation): Thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or a container. Exports: ScrollProgress.
- `search-input` (Inputs): Search field with a clear button, Escape to clear and a slash shortcut to focus. Exports: SearchInput.
- `segmented` (Inputs): Pick one of a few views or ranges. Smaller than tabs. Exports: Segmented.
- `select` (Inputs): Styled dropdown with groups, built on Radix Select. Exports: Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem.
- `separator` (Display): Horizontal or vertical divider. Exports: Separator.
- `shimmer-text` (Display): Text with a light sweep passing over it. Exports: ShimmerText.
- `sidebar` (Layout): Collapsible nav with groups, nested links and badges. Icon rail on desktop, slide-over on mobile. Exports: useSidebar, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarItem.
- `skeleton` (Feedback): Shimmering placeholder for content that is loading. Exports: Skeleton.
- `slider` (Inputs): Native range input with a filled track and floating value bubble. Exports: Slider.
- `spinner` (Feedback): Tiny CSS spinner that inherits text color. Exports: Spinner.
- `spotlight-card` (Display): Card with a glow and border highlight that follow the cursor. Exports: SpotlightCard.
- `stat-card` (Data): KPI tile with value, trend delta and a sparkline slot. Exports: StatCard.
- `stepper` (Navigation): Horizontal steps for multi-step forms and onboarding. Exports: Stepper.
- `switch` (Inputs): On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately. Exports: Switch.
- `table` (Display): Dense table parts with hover rows and a selected state. Exports: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell.
- `tabs` (Navigation): Underline or pill tabs on Radix Tabs. Exports: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent.
- `tag-input` (Inputs): Type and press Enter to add chips. Backspace removes the last. Exports: TagInput.
- `tilt-card` (Display): 3D card that tilts toward the cursor with a moving sheen. Exports: TiltCard.
- `timeline` (Display): Vertical activity feed with tone-colored markers. Exports: Timeline.
- `toast` (Feedback): Call toast.success() from anywhere. No provider needed. Exports: toast, Toaster.
- `toggle` (Inputs): Two-state button for favourite, bold or mute. Announces its state to screen readers. Exports: Toggle.
- `tooltip` (Overlays): One-line hint on hover and focus. Exports: TooltipProvider, Tooltip.
- `tree-view` (Navigation): Nested expandable list with animated open and close. Exports: TreeView.
- `typewriter` (Display): Types, holds and deletes phrases in a loop. Static for reduced motion. Exports: Typewriter.

## Blocks
- `block:admin-shell` (Layout): Full app frame: grouped sidebar with nested links, topbar with search, alerts and user menu, and a dashboard page. Uses: app-shell, avatar, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, charts, date-picker, dropdown-menu, kbd, sidebar, stat-card, timeline.
- `block:campaign-performance` (Marketing): Channel KPIs, weekly leads chart and a campaign budget table. Uses: badge, card, charts, progress, stat-card, table.
- `block:employee-directory` (HRMS): Searchable table with status filter, row selection, actions and pagination. Uses: avatar, badge, button, card, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, pagination, segmented, table.
- `block:hrms-overview` (HRMS): Headcount, attendance, department split and activity feed. Uses: avatar, card, charts, stat-card, timeline.
- `block:lead-pipeline` (Marketing): Drag-and-drop board with column totals and a keyboard-friendly move button. Uses: avatar, badge, button, card, toast.
- `block:leave-approvals` (HRMS): Manager inbox with tabs, balance bars and approve or reject toasts. Uses: avatar, badge, button, card, empty-state, progress, tabs, toast.
- `block:leave-request-form` (HRMS): Date range, approver combobox, multi-select notify list, working-day count and field validation. Uses: alert, button, calendar, card, combobox, date-picker, input, label, select, toast.
- `block:sign-in` (Auth): Login card with validation, loading button and an error alert. Uses: alert, button, card, checkbox, input, label.
